original_test_intent: Verify that each Type 17 Type Detail bitmask reports the approved simultaneous memory-device attributes, sets no reserved or version-undefined bits, is consistent with Memory Type/form factor/module design and remains semantically stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 records and SMBIOS version, bind the 16-bit raw mask to locator/population identity, decode every set bit with a versioned definition, preserve Other/Unknown and undefined bits explicitly, compare approved attributes/companion fields, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves expected attribute sets and reboot plan. No physical or ECC-setting change is required.
required_inputs: Expected raw mask or allowed attribute set per locator/device class
Applicable SMBIOS version and Type Detail bit definitions
Policy for reserved, Other, Unknown and newly introduced bits
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and approved inventory; do not alter DIMMs, ECC policy or firmware.
Preserve the entire numeric mask before decoding multiple simultaneous flags.
Decode only bits defined for the recorded SMBIOS version and report every reserved/unknown set bit.
Do not collapse multiple bits into a single text label or infer capabilities not represented by the mask.
Stop on undefined bits, identity ambiguity or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode every per-device mask bit, validate version/reserved rules and approved attribute/companion-field consistency, then compare pre/post reboot semantics.
Do not modify memory/firmware, invent bit meanings or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected masks/attribute sets and handling for special or version-new bits.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The decoded Type Detail line is relevant, but grep -A1 omits the record identity and raw mask needed to detect multiple, reserved or tool-unknown bits.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17 output; report handle/locator/population, raw 16-bit mask, each decoded bit with version status, undefined-bit mask and companion-field consistency.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type Detail scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and memory/ECC changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse the raw Type Detail mask per complete Type 17 identity, enumerate all set bits against the applicable SMBIOS revision, preserve undefined bits and compare the approved attribute set and companion fields before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 records whose memory devices expose one or more Type Detail attributes.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Type Detail bit definitions and authoritative module/platform design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds numeric-mask preservation, multi-bit completeness, version/reserved-bit checking and per-device consistency.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects silently omitted flags, reserved bits, decoded-label/tool-version gaps and attributes attached to the wrong locator.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected mask/attributes and applicable versioned definitions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Type Detail is descriptive inventory; it does not prove runtime mode, ECC enablement or performance behavior.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept a newer defined bit or device-class-specific combination only with its SMBIOS revision and authoritative definition recorded; reserved bits cannot be reinterpreted by convenience.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/device identity, expected masks/attributes and version policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17 records and SMBIOS version
Per-device raw mask, complete decoded-bit list, undefined/reserved mask and companion-field result
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw plus semantic mask diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Type Detail is a defined bitfield; missing expected masks are project inputs rather than source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw mask decoding and rule comparison are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw multi-bit mask, complete identity and version/reserved-bit analysis.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains versioned safe decoding while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates descriptive flags from runtime capability claims and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a friendly decoded label from hiding additional, reserved or unknown bits and validates that all simultaneous attributes belong to the intended device.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a finite 16-bit mask with versioned definitions; exhaustive decoding and baseline comparison are deterministic software operations.
